title.zh: 希琉嘉 · 石剪布与出枪敛枪
title.en: Sigrid / Dialyn / Astra · Rock–Scissors–Paper and spear cycles

summary.zh: 本站把璐洛洛的希格莉德动作与琉音/嘉音队友推荐，结合固定辅助机制整理成三人教学；并非作者这支队伍的完整实测轴。
summary.en: Site synthesis of Ruroro’s Sigrid actions and Dialyn/Astra teammate recommendations with fixed support mechanics; not the author’s fully tested rotation for this exact trio.

conditions.zh: 本站依据原作者正文与固定Gachabase整理条件教学，不是已观看视频逐帧复刻、固定秒轴或最高分保证。
conditions.en: Site-authored conditional teaching combines original written guides and fixed Gachabase; it is not a reproduction of watched footage, a timed script, or a maximum-score guarantee.

conditions.zh: 默认0影、无专武也按实际资源执行；影画/专武只改变注明条件，不凭总金数赠送资源。所有Q使用各自喧响。
conditions.en: At M0 without signatures, act on actual resources; configurations change only the stated conditions, not resources granted by total investment. Every Ultimate uses its own character’s Decibels.

conditions.zh: 站位嘉音→希格莉德→琉音：嘉音开场与Q转换指向希，琉音上一位为强攻希。希与琉、嘉的额外能力均满足；不假定有风属性浸染。
conditions.en: Order Astra→Sigrid→Dialyn gives Astra’s initial/Ultimate-converted entry to Sigrid and places an Attack agent before Dialyn. Additional Abilities are enabled; no Gale Contamination is assumed.

conditions.zh: 先完成石头→剪刀→布，布命中才挂恶意投诉；90好评升级终结技与真实连携、敌人失衡分开。若需要希格莉德破阵，必须保留实际连携入口。
conditions.en: Complete Rock→Scissors→Paper and hit with Paper for Malicious Complaint. The 90-Review upgraded Ultimate, real Chains, and actual Stun are distinct. Sigrid’s Formation Breaker requires a real Chain entry.

label.zh: 开局准备
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先唱、完整石剪布，再补出枪机会
objective.en: Start Cadenza, complete all three Dialyn EX stages, then prepare a spear use

title.zh: 嘉音点E驻唱，命中后交快支
title.en: Tap Astra Special, then follow the actual assist

input.zh: 点按特殊技命中目标；已经驻唱时切回嘉音会自动衔接此招，不再重复长按。
input.en: Tap Special and hit the target; returning to Astra during Cadenza automatically links this skill, so do not add a redundant hold.

trigger.zh: 需要建立/恢复驻唱，或为主攻制造合法入场；无需满能开唱。
trigger.en: Cadenza or a legal carry entry needs restoring; starting it does not require full Energy.

complete.zh: 确认驻唱与快支提示；实际入场时嘉音有25能量才追加震音并施加核心加攻。
complete.en: Confirm Cadenza and the assist prompt; Astra needs 25 Energy at entry to fire Tremolo and grant the core ATK buff.

reason.zh: 开唱、命中生成快支和耗能加攻是不同条件。
reason.en: Starting Cadenza, hitting to create an assist, and spending Energy for ATK are separate conditions.

fallback.zh: 打空则重新瞄准；没有对应快支就普通切换并跳过下一快支步骤，不计精准支援加攻。
fallback.en: Re-aim after a miss; without the corresponding prompt, switch normally and skip the next assist step without claiming its ATK proc.

signal.zh: 对应角色的快支提示实际出现。
signal.en: The corresponding character’s Quick Assist prompt actually appears.

input.zh: 仅在该角色快支提示出现时按切换键。
input.en: Press Switch only when this character’s Quick Assist prompt appears.

trigger.zh: 前一步实际命中并生成对应提示，站位符合本方案。
trigger.en: The previous action actually hit and produced the matching prompt, with the required squad order.

complete.zh: 确认该角色通过快速支援接手；嘉音实际耗能才计入场加攻。
complete.en: Confirm this character entered through Quick Assist; count the entry ATK buff only if Astra actually spent Energy.

reason.zh: 普通切换与快速支援分开，避免虚构资源和增益。
reason.en: Separate ordinary switching from Quick Assist to avoid fictitious resources or buffs.

fallback.zh: 提示已消失则普通切入；希格莉德快支不是出枪式，佩洛伊斯仍需30日珥才接天光第三段。
fallback.en: If the prompt expired, switch normally. Sigrid’s Quick Assist is not Unbridled Spear; Pyrois still needs 30 Solar Prominence for the Celestial Light stage-3 shortcut.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

input.zh: 点按当前强化特殊技；可选在石头/剪刀后插至多两段猜拳普攻。
input.en: Tap the current EX Special; optionally weave up to two Rock, Paper, Scissors Basics after Rock/Scissors.

trigger.zh: 当前没有剪刀/布替换，能量≥25；计划连续三段时先确认75能量。
trigger.en: No Scissors/Paper replacement is active and Energy is 25+; reserve 75 for an uninterrupted full sequence.

complete.zh: 确认石头发动；下一EX在8秒内替换为剪刀，重击命中才加7.5好评。
complete.en: Confirm Rock activated; the next EX becomes Scissors for 8s. Its heavy hit must connect for 7.5 Reviews.

reason.zh: 石→剪→布是三次独立耗能；核心F投诉使随后失衡延长2秒、易伤倍率增加30%，不是石头就挂齐。
reason.en: Rock–Scissors–Paper spends Energy three times. At core F, Paper’s complaint adds 2s and 30% Stun multiplier to the following Stun; Rock alone does not apply it.

fallback.zh: 能量不足先补资源；替换过期按真实技能提示重开。空挥布先补命中，不把强开连携窗口当敌人失衡。
fallback.en: Recover resources if underfunded; restart from the actual skill after replacement expiry. Land Paper after a miss; forcing a Chain window is not the same as Stun.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

input.en: Tap the current EX Special; optionally weave up to two Rock, Paper, Scissors Basics after Rock/Scissors.

trigger.zh: 石头已发动且8秒替换仍有效，能量≥25。
trigger.en: Rock has activated, its 8s replacement is still active, and Energy is 25+.

complete.zh: 确认剪刀发动；下一EX在8秒内替换为布，重击命中才加7.5好评。
complete.en: Confirm Scissors activated; the next EX becomes Paper for 8s. Its heavy hit must connect for 7.5 Reviews.

label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

input.en: Tap the current EX Special; optionally weave up to two Rock, Paper, Scissors Basics after Rock/Scissors.

trigger.zh: 剪刀已发动且8秒替换仍有效，能量≥25。
trigger.en: Scissors has activated, its 8s replacement is still active, and Energy is 25+.

complete.zh: 布实际命中才挂恶意投诉；三段重击全中只直接加22.5好评，不保证90。
complete.en: Paper must actually hit to apply Malicious Complaint; three heavy hits directly add only 22.5 Reviews, not a guaranteed 90.

label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 普攻第四段命中，补一次敛枪
title.en: Land Basic 4 for one Converging Spear use

input.zh: 按当前保留段数继续点普攻，直到第四段下劈命中。
input.en: Continue Basics from the retained stage until the fourth-stage plunge connects.

trigger.zh: 当前没有敛枪机会，或巡空枪势已结束；已有机会则跳过本步先敛枪。
trigger.en: There is no Converging Spear use, or Aerial Patrol Spear expired; if a use already exists, skip this step and spend it first.

complete.zh: 第四段实际命中才进入/刷新枪势并取得1次机会，上限1；前三段不算出枪式。
complete.en: Only the fourth-stage hit enters/refreshes the stance and grants one use, capped at one. Earlier Basics are not Unbridled Spear.

reason.zh: 先确认命中与机会，避免连用出枪式覆盖资源。
reason.en: Verify the hit and use before another Unbridled Spear overwrites it.

fallback.zh: 落点打空就重新贴近；也可用合法闪反或EX出枪恢复，招架本身不算，需接支援突击命中。
fallback.en: Reposition after a missed plunge; a valid Counter or EX can restore it. A parry alone is insufficient: the Assist Follow-Up must hit.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

prep.zh: 希快支结束后普通切琉音；快支本身不给敛枪机会。琉音能量不足75时先打基础动作补资源，不把开局写成必定三EX。
prep.en: After Sigrid’s assist, switch normally to Dialyn; the assist itself grants no spear use. Below 75 Dialyn Energy, build resources first rather than promising three opening EXs.

prep.zh: 布命中后普通切希格莉德。已有恶意投诉且不需刷新辅助时，可跳过琉音三段。
prep.en: After Paper hits, switch normally to Sigrid. If the complaint is already active and support needs no refresh, skip Dialyn’s three stages.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Normal cycle

objective.zh: 出枪与敛枪交替，辅助缺失再补
objective.en: Alternate Unbridled and Converging Spear; refresh support only when needed

title.zh: 普攻第四段命中，补一次敛枪
title.en: Land Basic 4 for one Converging Spear use

label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 消耗机会，打当前段敛枪
title.en: Spend one use on the current Converging stage

input.zh: 枪势与次数有效时长按普攻；按实际当前段数发动，不强写第几段。
input.en: Hold Basic with the stance and a use available; follow the actual current stage rather than an assumed stage number.

trigger.zh: 巡空枪势仍有效且有1次敛枪机会；没有机会先用出枪式命中。
trigger.en: Aerial Patrol Spear is active and one use remains; without it, land an Unbridled Spear first.

complete.zh: 确认当前敛枪发动并推进段数；第三段后重置。第一/二段架势实际格挡成功才刷新枪势与一次机会。
complete.en: Confirm the current stage activated and advanced; stage three resets the sequence. Only a successful stage-1/2 shield block refreshes stance and a use.

reason.zh: 连携爆发与平时逐次出枪分开处理，不能把普通长按当无限三连。
reason.en: Distinguish the Chain burst from ordinary one-use cycles; a regular hold is not an unlimited triple sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有破阵则按普通敛枪次数处理；枪势过期先补出枪，段数只降低1而非凭空保留三段。
fallback.en: Without Formation Breaker, use ordinary available Converging uses; restore an expired stance first. Expiry lowers the stage by one rather than preserving stage three.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 枪势内碎玉，重新取得敛枪
title.en: Shattered Jade inside the stance refills a use

input.zh: 巡空枪势内且EX能量够时点按强化特殊技，确保命中。
input.en: With Aerial Patrol Spear active and enough EX Energy, tap EX and hit.

trigger.zh: 当前敛枪机会已用、枪势尚未结束；已有机会时先敛枪，不照表覆盖。
trigger.en: The current Converging use is spent but the stance remains. Spend an existing use first instead of overwriting it.

complete.zh: 碎玉实际命中刷新枪势并取得1次敛枪；正常普攻段数保留。
complete.en: An actual Shattered Jade hit refreshes the stance and grants one Converging use while retaining the normal Basic stage.

reason.zh: 同一个EX键在无枪势时变成乱琼，不能假定一直是碎玉。
reason.en: The same EX input becomes Scattered Jade outside the stance; it is not always Shattered Jade.

fallback.zh: 枪势已断可用乱琼159100004命中恢复，或普四；能量不足回普四/合法闪反。
fallback.en: If the stance expired, Scattered Jade 159100004 or Basic 4 can restore it on hit; without Energy, use Basic 4 or a valid Counter.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

fallback.en: If the prompt expired, switch normally. Sigrid’s Quick Assist is not Unbridled Spear; Pyrois still needs 30 Solar Prominence for the Celestial Light stage-3 shortcut.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

prep.zh: 有敛枪机会就跳过首个普四，先消耗。依次推进当前段数；达到第三段后按实际状态重开，不把两个事件误算完整三段。
prep.en: With an existing use, skip the first Basic 4 and spend it. Advance the actual current stages; two events are not automatically a full triple sequence.

prep.zh: 恶意投诉或琉音增伤需要重建时，先按开局石→剪→布三步补齐；嘉音增益仍足够则跳过末尾补唱/快支。第三段敛枪已启动后才可切辅助合轴，未启动不算后台伤害。
prep.en: If the complaint or Dialyn’s damage buff needs rebuilding, repeat all three opening EX stages. Skip the final Astra refresh/assist pair if sufficient. Overlap a support action only after Converging stage 3 starts, not before.

label.zh: 失衡爆发
label.en: Stun burst

objective.zh: 实际连携触发破阵；第二次连携按影画处理
objective.en: Use a real Chain for Formation Breaker; handle the second Chain by Mindscape

title.zh: 连携命中失衡目标，进入破阵
title.en: Hit the Stunned target with Chain for Formation Breaker

input.zh: 实际连携窗口出现且可选希格莉德时选择她；嘉音Q转换也必须按真实提示。
input.en: Select Sigrid only in a real Chain window where she is offered; Astra’s Ultimate conversion also requires its actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 精英/首领已实际失衡，本轮尚未触发破阵。
trigger.en: The Elite/Boss is actually Stunned and Formation Breaker has not triggered this Stun.

complete.zh: 连携发动获得砥砺；命中刷新枪势。首个符合条件的命中才触发破阵。
complete.en: Chain activation grants the Converging damage buff; hitting refreshes stance. Only the first eligible hit grants Formation Breaker.

reason.zh: 琉音升级终结技不是此连携，不能拿它自动触发砥砺或破阵。
reason.en: Dialyn’s upgraded Ultimate is not this Chain and does not automatically grant its Chain-only buff or Formation Breaker.

fallback.zh: 没有合法连携就留在普通出枪/敛枪循环；若实际提示升级Q，按Q处理且不套用下一步破阵。
fallback.en: Without a legal Chain, stay in the normal spear cycle. If the prompt is an upgraded Ultimate, treat it as Ultimate and do not assume Formation Breaker.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 破阵：连续完成三段敛枪
title.en: Formation Breaker: complete all three Converging stages

input.zh: 确认破阵后长按普攻，让第一至第三段连续完成。
input.en: Once Formation Breaker is confirmed, hold Basic through stages one to three.

trigger.zh: 希格莉德连携实际首次命中本轮失衡的精英/首领并获得破阵；非失衡不成立。
trigger.en: Sigrid’s Chain actually hit a Stunned Elite/Boss and granted Formation Breaker this Stun; a non-Stunned target is insufficient.

complete.zh: 第三段结束破阵并恢复先前敛枪段数；M0同一目标本次失衡仅一次，破阵敛枪不会打开连携窗口。
complete.en: The third stage ends Formation Breaker and restores the saved Converging stage. At M0 it is once per target per Stun, and these hits do not open Chain windows.

reason.zh: 连携爆发与平时逐次出枪分开处理，不能把普通长按当无限三连。
reason.en: Distinguish the Chain burst from ordinary one-use cycles; a regular hold is not an unlimited triple sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有破阵则按普通敛枪次数处理；枪势过期先补出枪，段数只降低1而非凭空保留三段。
fallback.en: Without Formation Breaker, use ordinary available Converging uses; restore an expired stance first. Expiry lowers the stage by one rather than preserving stage three.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 嘉音Q：开启两次共享转换
title.en: Astra Ultimate: enable two shared conversions

input.zh: 嘉音本人Q就绪时切回发动，确保命中；按随后提示接指定角色。
input.en: With Astra’s own Ultimate ready, switch to her, use it, and hit; take the following displayed entry.

trigger.zh: 本人喧响足够，剩余窗口允许；这不是队友开Q后的共享资源。
trigger.en: Her own Decibels are sufficient and the window allows it; teammates’ Ultimates do not supply a shared meter.

complete.zh: 下两次快支被替换为连携，次数全队共享；不因此让敌人失衡。
complete.en: The next two Quick Assists become Chains, shared across the squad; this does not itself make the enemy Stunned.

reason.zh: 转换提供真正的连携入口，但不是任意角色无限连携。
reason.en: Conversion supplies a real Chain entry, not unlimited Chains for any character.

fallback.zh: Q未好就跳过本步及依赖它的转换步骤，继续已有主攻资源；提示失效不强切当连携。
fallback.en: If unavailable, skip this and its dependent converted entries and spend existing carry resources; an expired prompt is not a Chain.

signal.zh: Q实际命中，指定角色的转换连携提示出现且有剩余次数。
signal.en: The Ultimate actually hits and the specified character’s converted Chain prompt appears with a charge remaining.

title.zh: 嘉音转换连携，回到当前敛枪
title.en: Take Astra’s converted Chain and return to the saved stage

input.zh: 实际连携窗口出现且可选希格莉德时选择她；嘉音Q转换也必须按真实提示。
input.en: Select Sigrid only in a real Chain window where she is offered; Astra’s Ultimate conversion also requires its actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 嘉音Q已实际发动、转换次数未耗尽，希格莉德的转换连携提示出现。
trigger.en: Astra’s Ultimate was used, a conversion remains, and Sigrid’s converted Chain prompt appears.

complete.zh: 命中取得1次敛枪；M0–5同目标同失衡不再进破阵，M6实际连携命中失衡敌人才可再次进入。
complete.en: The hit grants one Converging use. M0–5 cannot re-enter Formation Breaker on this target this Stun; M6 requires another actual Chain hit on a Stunned enemy.

reason.zh: 琉音升级终结技不是此连携，不能拿它自动触发砥砺或破阵。
reason.en: Dialyn’s upgraded Ultimate is not this Chain and does not automatically grant its Chain-only buff or Formation Breaker.

fallback.zh: 没有合法连携就留在普通出枪/敛枪循环；若实际提示升级Q，按Q处理且不套用下一步破阵。
fallback.en: Without a legal Chain, stay in the normal spear cycle. If the prompt is an upgraded Ultimate, treat it as Ultimate and do not assume Formation Breaker.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 消耗机会，打当前段敛枪
title.en: Spend one use on the current Converging stage

input.zh: 枪势与次数有效时长按普攻；按实际当前段数发动，不强写第几段。
input.en: Hold Basic with the stance and a use available; follow the actual current stage rather than an assumed stage number.

trigger.zh: 巡空枪势仍有效且有1次敛枪机会；没有机会先用出枪式命中。
trigger.en: Aerial Patrol Spear is active and one use remains; without it, land an Unbridled Spear first.

complete.zh: 确认当前敛枪发动并推进段数；第三段后重置。第一/二段架势实际格挡成功才刷新枪势与一次机会。
complete.en: Confirm the current stage activated and advanced; stage three resets the sequence. Only a successful stage-1/2 shield block refreshes stance and a use.

reason.zh: 连携爆发与平时逐次出枪分开处理，不能把普通长按当无限三连。
reason.en: Distinguish the Chain burst from ordinary one-use cycles; a regular hold is not an unlimited triple sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有破阵则按普通敛枪次数处理；枪势过期先补出枪，段数只降低1而非凭空保留三段。
fallback.en: Without Formation Breaker, use ordinary available Converging uses; restore an expired stance first. Expiry lowers the stage by one rather than preserving stage three.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

title.zh: 枪势内碎玉，重新取得敛枪
title.en: Shattered Jade inside the stance refills a use

input.zh: 巡空枪势内且EX能量够时点按强化特殊技，确保命中。
input.en: With Aerial Patrol Spear active and enough EX Energy, tap EX and hit.

trigger.zh: 当前敛枪机会已用、枪势尚未结束；已有机会时先敛枪，不照表覆盖。
trigger.en: The current Converging use is spent but the stance remains. Spend an existing use first instead of overwriting it.

complete.zh: 碎玉实际命中刷新枪势并取得1次敛枪；正常普攻段数保留。
complete.en: An actual Shattered Jade hit refreshes the stance and grants one Converging use while retaining the normal Basic stage.

reason.zh: 同一个EX键在无枪势时变成乱琼，不能假定一直是碎玉。
reason.en: The same EX input becomes Scattered Jade outside the stance; it is not always Shattered Jade.

fallback.zh: 枪势已断可用乱琼159100004命中恢复，或普四；能量不足回普四/合法闪反。
fallback.en: If the stance expired, Scattered Jade 159100004 or Basic 4 can restore it on hit; without Energy, use Basic 4 or a valid Counter.

label.zh: 嘉音切控后仍在前场驻唱；队友真实支援/连携入场且嘉音耗25能量，才给该入场角色加攻。
label.en: Astra stays on stage in Cadenza after control changes; an actual assist/Chain entry and her 25-Energy spend are required for that entrant’s ATK buff.

prep.zh: 确认目标真实失衡且有恶意投诉；只在可选希的实际连携窗口开始。若琉音给的是升级Q，不执行前两步破阵假设。
prep.en: Verify actual Stun and Malicious Complaint, then start only from a real window offering Sigrid. A Dialyn-upgraded Ultimate does not justify the first two Formation Breaker steps.

prep.zh: 嘉音Q未好可跳过中间Q/转换/依赖敛枪三步，直接按实际枪势与次数续出枪。M6第二连携若实际触发破阵，则该次长按完成三段；M0–5只打恢复段数的一次。
prep.en: Without Astra Ultimate, skip its conversion and dependent Converging step, then continue by actual stance/uses. At M6, a second Chain that truly triggers Formation Breaker allows another triple hold; M0–5 get one use at the restored stage.

prep.zh: 末尾EX只在窗口足、枪势有效且没有未用敛枪机会时补；不足就结束爆发。本人Q可在就绪且需要出枪时替代补充，不与琉音升级Q重复计免费次数。
prep.en: Use the final EX only with enough time, active stance and no unspent use; otherwise finish. A ready personal Ultimate may supply an Unbridled Spear when needed, without double-counting Dialyn’s upgraded Ultimate.

text.zh: 嘉音1影入战增加1000自身喧响且攻击命中叠减抗；仍以本人Q实际就绪为准，不保证每轮有Q。
text.en: Astra M1 adds 1000 personal starting Decibels and hit-based resistance reduction; her actual Ultimate readiness still governs, with no guarantee every cycle.

text.zh: 嘉音4影在连携/Q后15秒可无和弦触发快支；不代表无能量也能支付核心加攻的25点。
text.en: Astra M4 allows assists without Chords for 15s after Chain/Ultimate, but does not waive the 25-Energy requirement for the core ATK proc.

text.zh: 玲珑妆匣在任意队员合法支援/连携入场时回能（有冷却）；实际消耗至少25能量才叠全队增伤，不默认开场两层。
text.en: Elegant Vanity restores Energy on any teammate’s valid assist/Chain entry, subject to cooldown; its team damage stacks require actual spending of at least 25 Energy, not automatic opening stacks.

text.zh: 希1影第三段敛枪发动后再给枪势与一次机会，先看实际次数；机会溢出增强下一敛枪末击，但不视为可储存两次。
text.en: Sigrid M1 grants stance and another use on stage-3 Converging activation. Check the actual use; overflow strengthens the next finisher but does not store two uses.

text.zh: 希2影枪势延长2秒并提高自身喧响获取，容错增加；仍要实际命中出枪，不保证额外Q。
text.en: Sigrid M2 extends stance by 2s and increases personal Decibel gain, but still requires real Unbridled hits and does not guarantee an extra Ultimate.

text.zh: 希6影连携命中失衡敌人后可反复进破阵；每次仍需真实连携入口，嘉音Q仅两次全队共享转换。
text.en: Sigrid M6 removes the repeat Formation Breaker limit after Chain hits on Stunned enemies; each needs a real Chain entry, and Astra Ultimate still has only two shared conversions.

text.zh: 骁骑礼赞的两层分别来自普攻与强化特殊技重击命中；只重复一种不算两层，双层后才有无视冰抗。
text.en: Knight’s Extolment needs heavy hits from both Basic and EX Special for two stacks; repeating one type is insufficient, and Ice resistance ignore starts only at two.

text.zh: 琉1影好评积攒更快，但仍检查90门槛和实际客诉；不把石剪布固定成一次免费升级Q。
text.en: Dialyn M1 accelerates Review gain, but still check 90 Reviews and the actual Complaint; a full EX sequence is not a guaranteed free upgraded Ultimate.

text.zh: 琉4影开局增加20能量，仍检查三段合计75；不是直接补满。
text.en: Dialyn M4 adds 20 starting Energy; still check the 75 total for all three EXs rather than treating it as a full refill.

text.zh: 昨夜来电靠物理EX实际造成伤害积层，三层后才给全队暴伤；回能要求琉音位于后场。
text.en: Yesterday Calls stacks on actual Physical EX damage and grants team CRIT DMG only at three stacks; its Energy Regen requires Dialyn to be off-field.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音点E驻唱，命中后交快支: 点特殊技驻唱，命中后等快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按提示接快速支援: 看到对应角色快支提示再接
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.普攻第四段命中，补一次敛枪: 点按普攻直到第四段下劈命中
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.消耗机会，打当前段敛枪: 枪势和次数有效时长按普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.枪势内碎玉，重新取得敛枪: 巡空枪势中点按强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.连携命中失衡目标，进入破阵: 连携选希格莉德，命中失衡目标进入破阵
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.破阵：连续完成三段敛枪: 破阵时长按普攻，完成三段敛枪
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音Q：开启两次共享转换: 嘉音开终结技，按实际提示交棒
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音转换连携，回到当前敛枪: 嘉音转换连携时选希格莉德，再检查敛枪段数

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.仅在该角色快支提示出现时按切换键。: 看到指向该角色的快速支援提示时，按对应切换键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.巡空枪势内且EX能量够时点按强化特殊技，确保命中。: 巡空枪势内、能量够时点按强化特殊技，确保命中。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.实际连携窗口出现且可选希格莉德时选择她；嘉音Q转换也必须按真实提示。: 出现连携窗口且能选希格莉德时，选她入场。即使用了嘉音的终结技，也要等真正的连携提示。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.嘉音本人Q就绪时切回发动，确保命中；按随后提示接指定角色。: 需要开启转换、嘉音自己的终结技就绪时，切回嘉音按终结技并命中，再看随后出现哪位队友的提示。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1591: 想取得敛枪机会时点按普攻打到第四段下劈命中；先确认枪势及次数，再长按普攻。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100005: 点按特殊技，等攻击命中并进入驻唱
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100012: 喧响到「极」且终结技就绪时点按终结技，等命中

148100003: 持有客诉时长按普攻就是「送客」；不要求先点普攻，也不是按强化特殊技键。
With a Customer Complaint, hold Basic to use the send-off; no preliminary Basic taps or separate EX press.
159100001: 本路线要第四段下劈命中；从当前保留段数续按普攻，不要固定数四次按键。
Land the hit-4 downswing here. Tap Basic from the currently retained stage, not necessarily four new taps.
159100002: 枪势与次数都满足才长按普攻；接哪一段取决于当前保留段数，无固定点按次数。
Hold Basic when stance and charges permit. The resulting hit depends on your retained stage, not a fixed tap count.

1591: 想走下劈获得敛枪机会时，续普攻至第四段命中；再看枪势与次数决定是否长按普攻。
For the downswing route, continue to Basic hit 4. Hold Basic afterwards only if stance and charges permit.
